crossRefs.note: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from Yahweh’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the…
Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city: for from now on the…
Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter…
“Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.
On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.
Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious…
The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for…
Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished…
Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?
Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.

people.name: Abinoam
people.line: Father of Barak, the Israelite commander

people.name: Barak
people.line: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.

people.name: Deborah
people.line: Prophetess and judge who led Israel to victory over Canaanites.

translations.web: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’
translations.bsb: ‘Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, sing a song! Arise, O Barak, and take hold of your captives, O son of Abinoam!’
translations.kjv: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
translations.asv: Awake, awake, Deborah; Awake, awake, utter a song: Arise, Barak, and lead away thy captives, thou son of Abinoam.
